name: Five-Dimensional Time-Space
definition: Five-dimensional Time-Space with S3 continuity base and localized S2 fibers.

name: Continuity Domain
definition: Base continuity domain among localized S2 projections.

name: Localized Projection Fiber
definition: Localized S2 fiber over p in S3.

name: Time-Space Address
definition: Typed address carrying base/fiber, operative state, chirality, invariant residue, R/B, ordering, and History.

name: Chirality Corridor
definition: Pullback of T5 along an admissible S3 path.

name: Rainbow Road
definition: Ordered composition of admissible Portal transactions with retained witness History.

name: Readable Projection
definition: Optional readable projection that may identify formally distinct full states.

name: Local QFT Representation
definition: Local QFT representation of the operative state.

name: Local GR Representation
definition: Local GR representation of the operative state.

name: Induced QFT Transport
definition: Physical/readable QFT transport induced along a Time-Space Road; not derived here.

name: Induced GR Transport
definition: Physical/readable GR transport induced along a Time-Space Road; not derived here.

name: QFT-GR Common Ancestry Relation
definition: Pairs local QFT/GR representations that descend from one common operative state.
